name: Kayo Tomiyama
limitations: Partial mechanics, not a full-kit simulation. Source snapshot is community-maintained Lufelnet, not a live battle validation.
Source tier 0 is the default; explicit loadouts[id].characterResearch.sourceTier takes precedence, followed by loadouts[id].sourceTier and unit.sourceTier. No automatic awareness tier inference.
Stats default to sourced A0 level 80; equipment and potential bonuses are not silently included.
Navigator skill hooks must be dispatched by stepNavigator. Existing generic cooldown decrement owns the ally-action clock; do not also decrement in character hooks.
Random elemental ailment, Outdated Slang, A4 Highlight/Theurgy, A6 Encore and weapons need separate events or remain omitted.
Retro elemental-ailment multiplier needs per-target damage hook; do not multiply all outgoing damage by 1.5.
Navigator 15% stat transfer is omitted until attribute scope and equipped-stat inclusion are verified.
Pulsating Rhythm uses one refreshed two-turn stack group, capped at three; independent-stack expiry is not resolved by source.
Opening preparation follows KR/CN 4/8/8 action text; EN cooldown fields are zero but descriptions specify 4/8/8.
implemented: Three correct navigator skills, preparation/cooldown counts 4/8/8
Club flat Attack and ailment accuracy; Intermission SP; Retro base damage and capped Attack scaling
Beat gain and four-Beat Pulsating Rhythm; A1 opening buffs and A2 refund

Retro elemental-ailment multiplier needs per-target damage hook; do not multiply all outgoing damage by 1.5.
Navigator 15% stat transfer is omitted until attribute scope and equipped-stat inclusion are verified.
Pulsating Rhythm uses one refreshed two-turn stack group, capped at three; independent-stack expiry is not resolved by source.
Opening preparation follows KR/CN 4/8/8 action text; EN cooldown fields are zero but descriptions specify 4/8/8.

skill1.name: Club Okyann
skill1.description:
Increase party's Attack by 12% of Tomiyama's Attack for 1 turn (up to 4500/4950/5400/5850 of Attack), increase ailment accuracy by 35.0%/38.5%/37.8%/41.3%, and gain 1 Beat stack.
Cooldown Time: 4 ally actions.

skill2.name: Intermission
skill2.description:
Restore party's SP by 22/27/26/31, and grant 3 Beat stacks.
Cooldown Time: 8 ally actions.

skill3.name: Retro Dance Number
skill3.description:
Increase party's damage by 10.0%/11.0%/10.8%/11.8% for 3 turns. Increase damage by 1% for every 225 of Tomiyama's Attack (up to 4500/4950/5400/5850 of Attack).
Also increase damage dealt to foes with an elemental ailment by 1.5 times and gain 2 Beat stacks.
Cooldown Time: 8 ally actions.

skill_highlight.name: Stat Buff
skill_highlight.description: Increase all allies' corresponding attribute stats by 15% of Phantom Thief's respective attributes.

passive1.name: Toe-Tapping
passive1.description: For every 4 Beat stacks gained, inflict 1 random elemental ailment on the foe with the highest remaining HP.

passive2.name: Outdated Slang
passive2.description: When an ally inflicts an elemental ailment on a foe, increase that ally's damage by 15% for 2 turns. Also, 21% chance to grant 1 Beat stack.

awareness.name: Kayo Tomiyama
awareness.r0_detail: When using a skill, gain Beat stacks. When Beat stacks reach 4 or more, activate a Resonance, spending 4 Beat stacks to grant 1 Pulsating Rhythm stack to all allies. When allies have Pulsating Rhythm, increase Attack by 10%/15%/20%, Defense by 10%/15%/20% and ailment accuracy by 5%/7.5%/10% based on Tomiyama's level (effect increases at level 1/50/70). Lasts for 2 turns. Stacks up to 3 times, and effects increase based on number of stacks.
awareness.r1_detail: At the start of battle, gain 2 Beat stacks, and increase party's ailment accuracy by 35% for 1 turn.
awareness.r2_detail: After granting Pulsating Rhythm, 20% chance to gain 1 Beat stack.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Club Okyann and Intermission by 2.
awareness.r4_detail: When an ally uses a Highlight or Theurgy, 67% chance to gain 1 Beat stack.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill level of Retro Dance Number by 2.
awareness.r6_detail:
After activating Pulsating Rhythm, 25% chance to activate Encore, granting 1 additional Pulsating Rhythm.
Encore will not activate consecutively.

weapon4-1.name: Emerald Charmer
weapon4-1.description: Increase Attack by 12.0%/12.0%/16.0%/16.0%/20.0%/20.0%/24.0%. After using a support skill, 43.0%/56.0%/56.0%/69.0%/69.0%/82.0%/82.0% chance to gain 1 Beat stack.

weapon5-1.name: Retro Disco Style
weapon5-1.description: Increase Attack by 30.0%/30.0%/39.0%/39.0%/48.0%/48.0%/57.0%. After granting Pulsating Rhythm, 41.0%/54.0%/54.0%/67.0%/67.0%/80.0%/80.0% chance to gain 1 Beat stack. Increase buffs from Pulsating Rhythm by 26.0%/34.0%/34.0%/42.0%/42.0%/50.0%/50.0% more.

integration.definition: Replace the legacy record by id in the live registry. Do not merge legacy estimated skills or buffs.
integration.hooks: Initialize after live navigator construction; pass each selected navigator action through beforeNavigatorSkill and afterNavigatorSkill. Existing generic cooldown decrement owns the ally-action clock. beforeDamage remains available for a future elemental-ailment-targeted Retro multiplier.
integration.sourceTier: Explicit index 0..3: characterResearch.sourceTier, then sourceTier alias, then unit default, then 0. Coefficients retain upstream ordering.
